description_en: Associates a high-availability virtual IP address (HAVIP) with an Edge Node Service (ENS) instance or elastic network interface (ENI)
description_zh: 调用AssociateHaVip接口将HaVip绑定到ENS实例或ENS弹性网卡上
kebab_example: aliyun ens associate-ha-vip --ha-vip-id havip-5p14t0000 --instance-id i-50c40000 --instance-type EnsInstance --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssociateHaVip

parameters.help_en:
The type of the instance to be associated with the HAVIP. Valid values:

- EnsInstance (default): ENS instance

- NetworkInterface: elastic network interface (ENI)
parameters.help_zh:
要绑定HaVip的实例类型，取值：
- EnsInstance：云服务器ENS实例（默认）。
- NetworkInterface：弹性网卡实例，当绑定HaVip的实例为弹性网卡，该参数必须填写
parameters.name: instance_type
